description:
Get detailed community metrics for a specific job listing (applicants by status, average days per status, Community Signal) using its UUID.

The metrics window defaults to the last 30 days. When the user requests a longer period — e.g. "last 6 months", "last year", "since January" — compute startDate and endDate from that phrase and pass them explicitly.

endDate.description: End of the metrics window in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to today if omitted.

jobId.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the job listing.

startDate.description: Start of the metrics window in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Compute from natural-language ranges: 'last 6 months' → today minus 6 months, 'last year' → today minus 12 months. Defaults to 30 days ago if omitted.

name: get_job_details
